reason: They don't name the payment partner, the fee per transaction or when the money hits my account, and that's the whole question for me. My regulars already pay at the terminal, so I won't put an unknown fee on my margins just for reviews and a loyalty stamp, even if the first three months are free.
objection: The per-transaction fee is charged on top and nobody says how much or how fast I get paid. On café tickets of 10-20 lari, a couple of percent plus a delay in cash can eat more than the 59 lari plan itself.
would_change_my_mind: A named Georgian bank as the partner, a fee at or below my current terminal rate, and next-day payout, all in writing before I sign.
